texto:
Urban farming is becoming more popular in big cities around the world. It is the practice of growing food, like vegetables and herbs, in urban areas. Instead of large fields in the countryside, people use small spaces inside the city. This idea is not new, but new methods are making it easier for everyone.

There are many benefits to urban farming. First, it gives people access to fresh and healthy food. Sometimes, food in big supermarkets travels a long distance, but with urban farms, the food is local. This also helps the environment because there is less transportation needed. Another great benefit is that it builds community. People work together in community gardens, share what they grow, and learn from each other.

You can find these small farms in many different places. Some people use their balconies or rooftops. Others join community gardens in parks or empty lots. It’s a wonderful way to connect with nature and your neighbors, even in a busy city.

preguntas.pregunta: What is the main idea of the text?

opciones.A: Farming is only possible in the countryside.
opciones.B: Urban farming is a positive practice for cities and their communities.
opciones.C: People in cities do not like fresh vegetables.
opciones.D: New methods have made all farming more difficult.
opciones.E: Community gardens are only for expert farmers.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B porque el texto describe la agricultura urbana de manera positiva, destacando sus múltiples ventajas. Menciona beneficios como el acceso a 'fresh and healthy food' y cómo 'it builds community'. The text focuses on the positive aspects of this growing trend in cities. Las otras opciones son incorrectas: A es lo contrario de lo que dice el texto ('people use small spaces inside the city'). C no se menciona en absoluto. D es incorrecta porque el texto dice que los nuevos métodos la están haciendo 'easier for everyone'. E no se menciona; el texto sugiere que la gente aprende junta.

preguntas.pregunta: From the text, we can infer that...

opciones.A: food from big supermarkets is always fresher.
opciones.B: urban farming requires a lot of space.
opciones.C: transporting food over long distances can be bad for the environment.
opciones.D: people in cities have no connection to nature.
opciones.E: growing herbs is more popular than growing vegetables.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. El texto no lo dice directamente, pero podemos inferirlo. Dice que la comida de los supermercados 'travels a long distance' y que la agricultura urbana 'helps the environment because there is less transportation needed'. This implies that the transportation required for supermarket food has a negative environmental impact. Las otras opciones son incorrectas: A es lo contrario de lo que se infiere. B es incorrecta, ya que el texto menciona 'small spaces'. D es incorrecta; el texto sugiere que la agricultura urbana es una forma de 'connect with nature'. E no se compara la popularidad de hierbas y verduras.
